1.consolidated_definition: Pez marino de hasta 30 cm de longitud, con bandas alternas de color amarillo y azul, reflejos plateados en el cuerpo y dos bandas negras, y aletas amarillas; su carne es apreciada. Pomadasyidae; Anisotremus virginicus.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Marine fish reaching up to 30 cm in length, with alternating bands of yellow and blue color, silver reflections on the body, and two black bands, and yellow fins; its flesh is prized. Pomadasyidae; Anisotremus virginicus.
